title: Wegleitung zur Steuererklärung 2025 für natürliche Personen
why_needed: Official guide for the 2025 return: income, deductions, deadlines and filing rules.
notes: Print code 15500.a.06.25; no print date shown. States filing deadline 31 March 2026 and BalTax Online as the electronic channel.

title: Steuererklärung 2025, Hauptformular Seite 1-4 für natürliche Personen
why_needed: Main cantonal and federal return form; shows every section of the return.
notes: View copy (Ansichtsexemplar), form code 15000.a.02.25. bs.ch says view copies must not be used; file through BalTax Online with the submission code. Contains the BalTax and Dr. Tax submission code field.

title: Einlagemappe für Steuerunterlagen BalTax 2025
why_needed: Folder for supporting documents (Belege) that goes with the return.
notes: View copy, form code 15001.a.01.25. Gives a submission code for BalTax filing or for paper filing with attachments.

title: Steuererklärung 2025 - Ihr persönlicher Einreichungscode
why_needed: Personal submission code and e-filing instructions for BalTax Online or Dr. Tax.
notes: Dated February 2026; view copy, form code 15003.a.01.25. Known in search results as Steuererklärungsschreiben BalTax. Title shown with an en dash in the PDF. Does not say whether a signature is needed.

title: Wertschriftenverzeichnis 2025 (Formular W)
why_needed: Securities and crypto holdings as of 31 December 2025; crypto is declared here.
notes: View copy; file code 15005. Crypto is listed under section B (assets without withholding tax deduction). Also used for the withholding tax refund.

title: Berufskosten 2025 (Formular B)
why_needed: Professional expenses for employees and side jobs.
notes: View copy; file code 15020. Sections: lump sum, commuting, meals (incl. shift work), other job costs, side job.

title: Liegenschaftenverzeichnis 2025 (Formular L)
why_needed: Real estate in Switzerland and abroad, if the person owns property.
notes: View copy; file code 15010. Covers tax values and rental income.

title: Antrag auf Anrechnung ausländischer Quellensteuern (DA-1) und zusätzlichen Steuerrückbehalt USA (R-US164) 2025
why_needed: Credit for foreign withholding tax on foreign dividends and interest.
notes: View copy; file code 15006. Not Swiss Verrechnungssteuer.

title: Schuldenverzeichnis 2025 (Formular S)
why_needed: Private and business debts as of 31 December 2025, with interest paid.
notes: View copy; file code 15015. Includes mortgages and loans.

title: Formular K Krankheitskosten, Z Zuwendungen, F Kinderbetreuungskosten 2025
why_needed: Illness and disability costs, donations, and childcare costs.
notes: View copy; file code 15030. Front page K, back page Z and F.

title: Alimente A und Unterstützungen U 2025
why_needed: Maintenance payments and support payments; needed when separated or supporting relatives.
notes: View copy; file code 15025.

title: Tarife für die Einkommenssteuer ab Steuerperiode 2025 und die Vermögenssteuer ab Steuerperiode 2025, Ausgabe 2025
why_needed: Cantonal income and wealth tax tariffs for natural persons, 2025.
notes: Income tariffs A (single) and B (married, or single with dependants); wealth tariffs A and B. Explains reduced cantonal tax for Riehen and Bettingen residents.

title: Übersicht über die Einkommenssteuertarife für die Steuerperioden 2018 bis 2026
why_needed: Income tax tariffs including 2026; the only 2026 tariff found.
notes: Dated 18.12.2025 in the document. Income tariffs only; no 2026 wealth tax tariff found.

title: Verzeichnis der Ansätze, Devisenkurse, Abzüge und Freibeträge für die Steuern von natürlichen Personen (18000.a.01.25)
why_needed: Communal tax multipliers for Riehen and Bettingen for 2025, plus deduction and allowance caps.
notes: Edition dated 1 January 2025; an older 2012 header also appears. Same table also holds interest rates, fees and exchange rates.

title: Verzeichnis der Ansätze, Devisenkurse, Abzüge und Freibeträge für die Steuern von natürlichen Personen (18000.a.01.26)
why_needed: Communal tax multipliers for Riehen and Bettingen for 2026, plus deduction and allowance caps.
notes: Multi-year table with columns 2016 to 2026; some 2026 values are marked provisional in italics.

title: Steuern und Finanzen - Gemeinde Bettingen
why_needed: Bettingen communal rates as decided by the municipal assembly.
notes: Rates decided by the Gemeindeversammlung on 9 Dec 2025 for 2026. Page states no 2025 rate; the 2025 figures are in the 18000.a.01.25 PDF.

title: Spendenliste des Kantons Basel-Stadt, Ausgabe 2025
why_needed: Shows which recipients donations can be deducted for (Zuwendungen).
notes: Date is the listing date on the bs.ch Merkblätter page. Political parties appear with their own capped deduction.

title: Merkblatt betreffend den Abzug von Liegenschaftskosten mit Katalog für die Abgrenzung der abziehbaren Liegenschaftskosten von den nicht abziehbaren Anlagekosten
why_needed: Which property costs are deductible; needed when the person owns property.
notes: Edition 01.01.2026; applies to cantonal and federal tax from tax period 2020. Includes a flat-rate option.

title: Wegleitung und Tarife zur Quellenbesteuerung, Ausgabe 2026 (19000.a.02.26)
why_needed: 2026 source-tax tariffs, NOV request rules, recalculation deadlines and forms.
notes: NOV request by 31 March of following year, irrevocable (pp. 5, 11, 12). Recalculation deadline p. 12. Forms pp. 85-86. Contact steuerverwaltung@bs.ch. Another 2026 print run (01.26) also exists.

title: Wegleitung und Tarife zur Quellenbesteuerung, Ausgabe 2025 (19000.a.01.25)
why_needed: 2025 source-tax tariffs and NOV rules for the 2025 tax year.
notes: Same 31 March NOV deadline. Reports a mandatory NOV above a taxable-income threshold of CHF 120,000; confirm the wording in the guide.

title: Informationen zur Quellensteuer
why_needed: Entry page linking the 2025 and 2026 source-tax guides.
notes: Contains no NOV or recalculation rules; use the PDF guides for those.

title: Steuererklärung als natürliche Person einreichen
why_needed: Official filing channel, filing deadline, extension rules and fees for 2025.
notes: Filing deadline 31 March 2026; free extension to 30 September 2026; further extension CHF 40; portal https://esteuern.bs.ch/private; no signature needed for electronic filing.

title: Steuerportal und BalTax Online
why_needed: BalTax Online 2025 login via AGOV, third-party (Dr. Tax) submission, and client filing.
notes: Login button reads BalTax Online 2025; one-time ePortal registration; AGOV since June 2024; BalTax hotline +41 61 267 67 67; baltax@bs.ch.

title: Hinweise und Tipps zu BalTax 2025
why_needed: Practical BalTax tips: login, submission code, uploading receipts.
notes: Names BalTax as the official tool and does not mention Dr. Tax, which conflicts with the portal page.

title: Gesetz über die direkten Steuern (Steuergesetz, StG), SG 640.100
why_needed: Legal basis for income, wealth and deduction rules.
notes: Consolidated version, Stand 1 January 2026; confirm the version that applied to tax year 2025. Amended provisions are marked with asterisks. HTML viewer: https://www.gesetzessammlung.bs.ch/app/de/texts_of_law/640.100

title: Besteuerung von Kryptowährungen und von passivem Einkommen aus Verdiensten im Internet bei natürlichen Personen
why_needed: Tax treatment of crypto for 2025: wealth, gains, mining and staking income, crypto salary.
notes: Merkblatt 18023.a.01.26, dated 7 January 2026, applies to the 2025 tax year.
